description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score across epochs for three different data groupings: “Regular members,” “Members with near-duplicates,” and “Held-out data.” The x-axis is labeled “Epochs” and spans from 0.0 to approximately 3.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5, representing the training iteration count. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score” and ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05, indicating a normalized metric for translation quality. The “Regular members” are represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 0.03 at epoch 0.0 and rising steadily to about 0.18 by epoch 3.0. The “Members with near-duplicates” are shown as an orange dashed line with triangular markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 0.03 at epoch 0.0 and exhibiting a sharp, non-linear increase to a peak of about 0.35 by epoch 1.5 before leveling off slightly. The “Held-out data” is depicted as a solid green line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 0.03 at epoch 0.0 and increasing gradually to around 0.15 by epoch 3.0.
